sourceTitle: The Lay of Marie and Vignettes in Verse
description: "The Lay of Marie and Vignettes in Verse" by Matilda Betham is a poetic narrative and a collection of verses written in the early 19th century. The poem follows Marie, an Anglo-Norman minstrel in the 13th century, who navigates the complexities of her low station while being intertwined in the affairs of nobility, particularly amidst the backdrop of England losing Normandy.
